notes:
Matches should start much sooner, and a ghost player is gone.

Joining: until now a match server only started when someone pressed Play, so you waited about a minute in the queue while it booted. Now a server starts warming up while you are still in the lobby, about 30 seconds after your game opens, so it is usually ready by the time you press Play. The server also starts its match about 20 seconds sooner than before: it no longer waits a fixed 45 seconds before setting itself up, and the countdown before it loads the island is shorter.

Ghost player: when your PC hosted, the server's own hidden player (logged in with your name) was dropped out of the Battle Bus with everyone else. It no longer gets a character.

Smoother play: the server now sends game updates 60 times a second instead of 30, so other players' movement, shots and builds reach you sooner.

Behind the scenes: the problem reports the launcher sends are smaller and clearer, repeated messages are sent once with a count, and two small background processes the game leaves behind are now closed when you quit.

These changes have been built and tested, but not yet played through a full match. If a match misbehaves, send the log from the Logs tab.
